text:
Devon: Heads-up — starting preflight for the new eu-west9 GPU cluster bring-up. Main goals: KMS/HSM keys in place, least-priv IAM roles for node/service accounts, secrets provisioning, and basic policy checks before handing off to infra-oncall. Who can own the KMS side?

Maria: I can take KMS/HSM config. Quick Q — are we using GCP CMEK (HSM-backed) or a customer HSM gateway this time?

Devon: Using GCP CMEK with HSM-backed key ring for control plane secrets, but we also need to ensure our key-wrapping story supports Dedicated clusters with customer HSM later. For now, CMEK in the eu-west9 key ring.

Kevin: I'll own IAM bindings and node identity. Plan: create a short-lived service account per node-pool and bind only the required roles. Minimal list: 
```
roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1
roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (on the specific CMEK key)
roles/storage.objectViewer (if using GCS-backed artifacts)
```
Will template these in Terraform.

Anya: Also need to validate Secrets Manager access. Nodes should never have broad secrets access — use workload identity to map K8s SA -> GCP SA, then grant the SA access to specific secret versions.

Devon: +1. Add these checks to the gate: CMEK key exists, key is HSM-backed, SA has kms:encrypt/decrypt on key, K8s SA -> GCP SA mapping present, and secret versions are set to replication policy eu.

privsec-bot: Automated check queued: running baseline validations. Will post results in a few mins.

Oliver: I ran a quick quota check for eu-west9 GPUs — current soft limit for A100 is 60. If provisioning >40 nodes we should file a capacity increase request now (support ticket). Also note price delta: reserved nodes vs on-demand matters for Dedicated pools.

Kevin: Example IAM policy snippet I plan to apply (terraform):
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "cluster_key_decrypter" {
  crypto_key_id = var.cluster_cmek_key
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:${var.node_service_account_email}"]
}
```
This binds the SA to the key only — no project-wide KMS perms.

Maria: For HSM verification, checklist: 
- CMEK key location = eu-west9 keyRing
- keyProtectionLevel = HSM
- key rotation schedule set (90d)
- audit logs enabled for cloudkms.googleapis.com

Anya: Secrets provisioning checklist: 
- K8s secret controller configured with workload identity
- Secrets in Secret Manager labeled `cluster=eu-west9` and `env=prod`
- Access granted to GCP SA with `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` scoped to versions needed

privsec-bot: Baseline results: 
- CMEK key found: ✅ (projects/r-infra/locations/eu-west9/keyRings/eu9-ring/cryptoKeys/eu9-cluster-key)
- Key protection level: HSM ✅
- IAM binding missing: serviceAccount:infra-eu-node@r-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com lacks roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter ❌
- Secret labels: 4/5 secrets labeled correctly, 1 missing `env` label ❌
- Audit logs for cloudkms: not exported to log sink -> needs enablement ❌

Devon: Sounds like action items. Kevin — can you add that binding in the TF plan and include a data source guard so we don't open it project-wide?

Kevin: Yep. I'll push a draft PR with two commits: 1) tf binding, 2) policy tester that runs `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` in pipeline.

Maria: I'll add audit-log sink instructions to the runbook (where to route to /security-logs bucket + BigQuery view). Also adding rotation monitoring alert to pager duty.

Oliver: For GPU capacity: filing quota increase request now to avoid a late hold. Also flagging cost: estimated incremental spend for initial 20 A100 nodes ~ $27k/month on on-demand — noting for finance approval.

Anya: For the handoff checklist to infra-oncall, include: ticket numbers (quota/cost), TF PR link, key ARN + rotation schedule, secrets mapping doc link, and the privsec-bot green check after re-run.

privsec-bot: Re-run after changes recommended. Will re-scan once PR merged and labels fixed.

Devon: Next steps: Kevin and Maria to land IAM+audit fixes by EOD; Anya to patch secrets label and controller config; Oliver will update quota ticket and cost estimate in the ticket. I'll assemble a one-page handoff doc and drop it in #eng-infra-runbooks when privsec-bot shows green. :thumbsup:

Kevin: On it. PR soon.

Maria: Starting audit sink patch now.

Anya: Fixing labels and will redeploy the secret controller.

Devon: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for the preflight. If anything blocks, ping with @Devon or escalate to infra-oncall. :eyes:
